name: Mountaineering Tents
description: Four-season tents engineered with reinforced poles and low profiles to withstand high winds and heavy snow loading at altitude.

name: Mountain Huts
description: Staffed or self-service refuges found in ranges such as the Alps, offering climbers shelter, meals, and a base for early summit attempts.

name: Base Camps
description: Established at the foot of a mountain, base camps serve as logistical hubs where teams acclimatise, store supplies, and coordinate the expedition.

name: Emergency Shelters
description: Compact bivy sacks and space blankets carried as a last resort to preserve body heat if a team is caught out overnight unexpectedly.

name: Bivouac
description: A minimal, often unplanned overnight stop on route, using whatever natural or portable shelter is available to wait out darkness or weather.

name: High-Altitude Camps
description: A series of progressively higher camps used on major peaks to aid acclimatisation and shorten the final push to the summit.
